WHAT: iOS app teaching negotiation through progressive drills and live scenario practice. Duolingo-style technique isolation.

TECHNIQUE TREE:
- Chris Voss: labeling, mirroring, tactical empathy, no-oriented questions, accusation audit, calibrated questions
- Motivational Interviewing: reflective listening, double-sided reflections, developing discrepancy, eliciting change talk, OARS framework
- Cialdini / Influence: reciprocity, commitment/consistency, social proof, authority, liking, scarcity

CORE LOOP:
- Drill Mode: Show conversation snippet → identify what to label/mirror/reflect. Isolated reps, scored, progressive difficulty. This is what makes it different from 'just chatting with ChatGPT'
- Scenario Mode: Full conversation with AI playing the other side (salary negotiation, difficult client, conflict resolution). Scored on which techniques used and how well.

WHY IT'S INTERESTING:
- Everyone wants to negotiate better, nobody practices
- Subscription play
- Natural AI use case — AI can embody difficult negotiation partners
- Ned already validated concept with system prompts, noticed good teaching potential for labeling, mirroring, tactical empathy

STATUS: Idea stage, iOS app planned, architecture discussed March 30, 2026
